# Ida Vind

Ida Vind is an Overlæge (senior physician), Ph.D., and clinical lecturer (klinisk lektor) at Region Hovedstaden who serves as a steering committee member of [[danibd|DANIBD]], Denmark's national registry for inflammatory bowel disease [^src1][^src2]. 

DANIBD is a comprehensive database that encompasses patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treated at public Danish hospitals, covering all five Danish regions [^src3]. Region Hovedstaden, where Vind works, is the largest treating region in the network; during the period from October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023, the registry documented treatment of 33,381 IBD patients across the regions, with 10,523 receiving biologic medications [^src3]. The steering committee that Vind serves on represents medicine, surgery, nursing, and patient representation from all Danish regions, along with epidemiological and data management support from RKKP (Dansk Medicinsk Kvalitetsøkning) [^src3].

Vind's participation in DANIBD's governance extends across multiple reporting years. She is documented as a steering committee member in both the 2023 and 2024 reports [^src1][^src2], indicating sustained leadership involvement in the registry's operations and oversight.
